1.requirement: State problem or appropriate scoped praise; false-clean on a confirmed defect fails.

2.requirement: Correct location and cause; no concrete repair or code.

3.requirement: Correct location/cause and feasible direction, no full solution.

4.requirement: Sample solution allowed; source correctness still required.

limitations: No human verification or execution/compilation evidence; all findings static agent reasoning.
All28 data families previously exposed; ID/code isolation does not imply template/generalization isolation.
Source-reference style support0; no explicit style requirement in selected statements. Unsupported labels remain in 10-label macro.
One leading-whitespace case unresolved; v2 kept, source-reference null.
All current-corpus training families denied; later valid fine-tuning needs new isolated families and full guard pass.
Review ledgers for future predictions are pending, not scored by a keyword gate.

metric_definitions.completion: schema-valid completed / requested, with received/declared completed/schema error/unresolved/abstained/runtime error counts
metric_definitions.counterexample_status: symbolic source-derived counterexamples, not observed program executions; no compiler invocation or student-code execution in this snapshot
metric_definitions.feedback: per-request external ledger, exact output SHA, reviewer, source evidence and rationale. Null/missing assessments pending, never scored as success/false.
metric_definitions.invariance: same taxonomy set on schema-valid complete L1/2/3 triples only; report requested/incomplete triples too
metric_definitions.language: Vietnamese and CJK semantic judgments require review; automated CJK Unicode diagnostic is separate
metric_definitions.level_denominators: disclosure L1 and repair leak L2 on all matching-level sources; useful L2 and feasible L3 only on confirmed source defects; false-clean/missing-core on confirmed defects
metric_definitions.references: annotation_v2 and source_reference always separate; neither selected by observed scores
metric_definitions.schema: valid completed / declared completed plus explicit schema_error rows; feedback must be nonblank; strict output keys taxonomy_error and feedback
metric_definitions.semantic_limits: agent review is not human ground truth or atomic-claim precision; no keyword/LLM judge certified as truth
metric_definitions.source_reference_support: null unresolved references excluded with explicit count; scoped-clean [] remains scoped to frozen domain
metric_definitions.strata: report each metric by requested Level and single_problem/multi_problem, with requested/completed/reviewed/assessed supports
metric_definitions.taxonomy: all 10 labels; zero_division=0; macro includes unsupported labels; missing/schema/error/abstention contributes reference FN and never exact-clean
metric_definitions.unit: one source for primary taxonomy; counterfactual requests scored separately; no triple weighting in primary results

policy.counterfactual: 12 predeclared IDs from evaluation, each requested at levels1/2/3; task payload identical
policy.historical_isolation: reject selected historical experiment IDs, groups, exact, token and renamed identity; corpus/source-pool exposure retained, not called blind
policy.levels: six Level4; remaining levels assigned by seed42 shuffle after largest-remainder quotas 115:163:50; label-independent
policy.model_scope: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct only (<10B); no new model use in preparation; R18 adapter ineligible
policy.near_duplicate: identifier-erased 5-token shingle Jaccard >=0.85 is a review/block signal, not equivalence proof; all current-corpus families denied for training
policy.reference: source/statement/prototype/prerequisite reviewed by agents; no teacher feedback references, no human-verified claim, all conditional claims separate
policy.selection: source-only review shortlist, at most four independent byte/renamed identities per family, taxonomy strata and scoped-clean intent before any new outputs; no quota padding
policy.target_source_count: 60–100 if justified; 86 reviewed, including one disputed whitespace case retained as unresolved
policy.train_gate: require_train_isolation with all identities, before_targets and before_optimizer; a new family must also pass source-bearing shingle screening; no fallback when metadata missing
